item.title: Israelis mourn on the anniversary of the Oct. 7 as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
item.description: Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, attack that killed 1,200 people, and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that Palestinians still grapple with.

item.title: Actress Eva Marie Saint, who won an Oscar for 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
item.description: Saint won an Oscar for her portrayal of Edie, a Catholic schoolgirl whose longshoreman brother is murdered. She went on to star in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.

item.title: Cornell names former acting U.S. attorney general to review rape case
item.description: Cornell University names Sally Yates, former acting U.S. attorney general and career federal prosecutor, to lead an independent review into how the school handled a former student's rape allegations.

item.title: 'Here I am, my full, authentic self': Murray Hill charts his own course in 'Showbiz!'
item.description: Hill co-starred in HBO's Somebody Somewhere and has hosted drag king shows and queer cabarets. "This is my mantra … if you don't see yourself represented, go out and represent yourself," he says.

item.title: Here are the finalists for the 2026 National Book Awards
item.description: Three-time National Book Award finalist Edwidge Danticat and debut novelist Morgan Thomas are up for the fiction prize. Nonfiction books cover the prison system and music, and queer parenthood.
